info.title: 2Miners Pool API
info.description:
Public HTTP API of the [2Miners](https://2miners.com) mining pools. Every pool has its own host:
`https://<pool>.2miners.com/api` for PPLNS and `https://solo-<pool>.2miners.com/api` for SOLO. Pick the pool in the
server selector. All endpoints are read-only `GET` requests with JSON responses, except `POST /accounts/{login}/settings`.

### Conventions

- **Amounts** (balances, payments, rewards, payout thresholds) are integers in the pool's base unit of the coin,
  not in whole coins. Divide by the factor below to get coins:

  | Factor | Pools |
  |---|---|
  | 10^2 | NEXA |
  | 10^8 | AE, BCH, BEAM, BTC, CKB, KAS, NEB, PRL, RVN, XNA, ZEC |
  | 10^9 | ERG, ETC, ETHW, GRIN, MWC, QUAI (Shannon for ETC/ETHW) |
  | 10^12 | QTC, ZEPH |

  One exception: in `/blocks`, `reward` on ETC, ETHW, QUAI-SHA and QUAI-KawPoW is the full block reward in **wei** (10^18),
  sent as a decimal string.
- **Large numbers as strings.** Node fields in `/stats` (`height`, `difficulty`, `networkhashps`, ...) are strings, and so is
  block `reward` on ETC, ETHW, ERG, QTC and QUAI. Parse them as numbers.
- **Hashrates** are in hashes per second (graphs per second on GRIN and MWC).
- **Timestamps** are Unix time in seconds, except `now` and `updatedAt`, which are in milliseconds.
- **Empty lists** may be returned as `null` instead of `[]`.
- **Fields differ by coin.** The schemas list every field seen in production. Fields marked with a coin name appear only on those pools.
- **GRIN and MWC** report per-algorithm values: `hashrate`, `currentHashrate` and the share counters are objects keyed by
  algorithm (`"32"` for GRIN Cuckatoo32, `"31"` for MWC Cuckaroo31) instead of numbers. They also accept an optional
  `/{algo}` suffix on the range endpoints.
- **Range buckets**: `5m`, `30m` and `6h` (the bucket size of a chart point). Any other value returns `404`.
- An unknown miner address returns `404`.
- Responses are cached for up to about a minute, so polling more often than that returns the same data.

Source and issues: [github.com/2miners/apidoc](https://github.com/2miners/apidoc).

height_eu2.description: Height seen by the pool's second, third... server (multi-server pools: ERG, ETC, KAS, RVN). Also `height_eu3`, `height_eu4`, `height_eu5`.

blockReward.description: Block reward, in the pool's base unit (not on every coin).

dagSize.description: DAG size, bytes (ETC, ETHW, RVN, QUAI-KawPoW).

Node.description: Blockchain node as seen by the pool. All values are strings.

lastBlockFound.description: When the pool last found a block, Unix seconds.

eu_sessions.description: Open stratum sessions on the main server.

eu2_sessions.description: Open sessions on the second server (multi-server pools). Also `eu3_sessions`, `eu4_sessions`, `eu5_sessions`.

candidatesTotal.description: Blocks found but not yet confirmed.

maturedTotal.description: Matured blocks found by the pool, all time.

luck.description: Luck of the current round, percent (shares submitted / network difficulty × 100).

minPayout.description: Default minimum payout, in whole coins (not on every coin).

percent.description: Share of the pool hashrate, percent.

stats.description: Keyed by ISO country code (lower case, `unknown` when the IP has no country). On GRIN and MWC there is one more level: algorithm first, then country.

miners.description: Online miners, keyed by miner address.

minersMulti.description: GRIN/MWC: the same list split by algorithm.

finder.description: Address of the miner who found the block.

currentLuck.description: Round luck, percent (not on every coin).

reward.description: Block reward. A number in the pool's base unit on most pools; a decimal string on ETC, ETHW, ERG, QTC and QUAI (wei on ETC, ETHW and QUAI).

uncleRate.description: Share of uncle blocks (ETC, ETHW, ERG, QTC).

candidates.description: Found, not yet confirmed. `null` when empty.

luck.description: Luck over the last N blocks, keyed by N (`64`, `128`, `256`, `1024`; more on some pools).

finders.description: Address of the miner who found the block.

height.description: Block height (a number on most pools).

timestamp.description: Unix seconds (a string on most pools).

findersBlock.description: Latest blocks with their finders. `null` when empty.

address.description: Recipient (pools that pay one address per transaction).

totalPayees.description: Recipients in the transaction (pools that batch payouts).

txFee.description: Network fee, base unit (not on every coin).

balance.description: Unpaid balances of all miners, base unit.

immature.description: Immature rewards of all miners, base unit.

paid.description: Paid out, all time, base unit.

lastCreditHeight.description: Height of the last credited block.

lastCreditHash.description: Hash of the last credited block.

allowedMinPayout.description: Lowest threshold the miner may set, base unit.

allowedMaxPayout.description: Highest threshold the miner may set, base unit.

ipHint.description: Masked IP of the miner's most active worker, e.g. `x.x.x.75`. Needed to change settings.

paymentHubHint.description: Payout currency when the miner is paid in another coin.

immature.description: Rewards waiting for block maturity, base unit.

paid.description: Paid out, all time, base unit.

AccountStatsBlock.description: Balances. Fields without data are omitted.

rhr.description: Hashrate reported by the mining software, H/s (0 if not reported).

txFee.description: Network fee, base unit (not on every coin).

reward.description: Miner's reward from this block, base unit.

percent.description: Miner's share of the block reward (0..1).

inverval.description: Window length, seconds. The field name is misspelled in the API and is kept for compatibility.

reward.description: Rewards in the window, base unit.

numreward.description: Number of rewards in the window.

SumReward.description: Rewards over a time window. Always 5 items: 1 hour, 12 hours, 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days.

currentHashrate.description: Hashrate. A number on most pools; on GRIN and MWC an object keyed by algorithm.

hashrate.description: Hashrate. A number on most pools; on GRIN and MWC an object keyed by algorithm.

roundShares.description: Miner's shares in the current round.

sharesValid.description: A number on most pools; on GRIN and MWC an object keyed by algorithm.

sharesInvalid.description: A number on most pools; on GRIN and MWC an object keyed by algorithm.

sharesStale.description: A number on most pools; on GRIN and MWC an object keyed by algorithm.

payments.description: Latest payouts, up to `pageSize`. `null` when empty.

24hreward.description: Rewards in the last 24 hours, base unit.

24hnumreward.description: Number of rewards in the last 24 hours.

shares.description: CKB only: the miner's share counter.

ip.description: Full IP address of the miner's most active worker (see `config.ipHint`). Proves that the caller controls the rig.

key.description: Setting to change. Only `minPayout` is supported.

value.description: New payout threshold in the pool's base unit, as a decimal string, between `allowedMinPayout` and `allowedMaxPayout`.

currentHashrate.description: Hashrate. A number on most pools; on GRIN and MWC an object keyed by algorithm.

hashrate.description: Hashrate. A number on most pools; on GRIN and MWC an object keyed by algorithm.

x.description: Start of the bucket, Unix seconds.

actual.description: Hashrate measured by the pool, H/s, newest first. `null` when empty.

reported.description: Worker charts only: hashrate reported by the mining software (filled on RVN and XNA). `null` when empty.

valid.description: Valid shares per bucket, newest first. `null` when empty.

invalid.description: Invalid shares per bucket. `null` when empty.

stale.description: Stale shares per bucket. `null` when empty.
